gate_rows.evidence: The February 2026 CBO path supplies FY2026-FY2036 debt, primary deficit, net interest, GDP, and average-rate context.
Treasury raw custody supports a 3.409 percent total-interest-bearing-debt average rate as of June 30, 2026.
With zero admitted primary adjustment, debt and net-interest deltas remain zero; NET is not entered as a direct cut.
HLT, DEF, PAY, OAS, and formal REV primary effects remain unadmitted, so no nonzero shock may enter NET.
MSPD Table 3 and Table 5 diagnostics are not combined or reconciled to debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings.
Latest-month average rates do not supply annual maturity-bucket effective rates or rate stresses.
Borrowing timing, net interest receipts, and explicit other-financing items are not integrated with the maturity buckets.
No admitted policy-specific iteration recomputes debt, maturity, rates, output, receipts, and subsequent interest across years.

candidate_decision.next_strategy: complete REV/package admission first, then rerun NET with reconciled maturity, rate, timing, receipts, financing, and iterative feedback inputs

public_warning: Three evidence gates validate the baseline and zero-input identity; five dependencies block every nonzero effect. NET is an endogenous report, not a spending candidate, and no interest savings are admitted.
